correspondence: asset name == native_archive_inventory.json entries[].archive; the SHA-256 GitHub reports for each asset equals the author-recomputed hash of the bytes that are also pinned in archive_index.json and actual_record_index.csv

sealed_test_custody.passphrase_handed_over_by: member C author to the coordinator directly; never stored in the repository
sealed_test_custody.verify: gpg --decrypt --pinentry-mode loopback <asset> > container.zip, then check container.zip SHA-256 and every inner archive SHA-256 against this receipt

how_to_pull: curl -L -o <asset name> <browser_download_url> (needs repo read access, then sha256sum and compare with native_archive_inventory.json)
download_side_verification: GitHub reports the digest of the stored bytes, so this receipt proves the handover bytes equal the produced bytes; a full download-and-rehash pass is available on request
